verdict.rationale: Recruitee is an ATS that markets 'AI & Automation' features, so letting its AI connect to external MCP servers is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about an MCP client, MCP connectors, or consuming external tools. The REST API, webhooks and llms.txt documentation are about other agents and apps calling Recruitee, not Recruitee using MCP tools, so none of it counts here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
